privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.tracking.title: No tracking
privacy.tracking.text: Split uses no cookies, analytics, ads or third-party services.
privacy.browser.title: Data in your browser
privacy.browser.text: Your browser keeps the selected theme and language, the hints you have already seen, as well as encrypted copies of the splits you open, so they load faster and stay available offline. This data never leaves your device. You can remove it by clearing the site data in your browser settings.
privacy.server.title: Data on the server
privacy.server.text: Split contents are encrypted in your browser with the key from the link and stored on a server in Moscow (Russia) in encrypted form only, with no time limit. The key is never sent to the server, so only those who have the link can read the data. Share it only with people you trust.
privacy.logs.title: Technical logs
privacy.logs.text: The web server logs IP addresses, browser details and request times. The logs are needed to run and protect the service, are kept for no more than 15 days and are then deleted automatically. They are not used for tracking and are never shared.
privacy.operator.title: Controller
privacy.operator.text: The personal data controller is Andrew N. Markin. For any questions about data processing, including requests to access or delete your data, write to {email}.
split.about: Split is a free open-source app for splitting shared expenses with friends, family or colleagues. No sign-up is needed: share the link to the split, add participants, categories and expenses together, and get the settlements with as few transfers as possible. All the data is encrypted in the browser, so only those having the link can read it.
